trust_decision.summary: Client-side getQueryParam decides which decoded query-string keys may be expanded into nested object paths; its only guard skips keys that start with '__proto__[', so a '__proto__' segment in the second position of a three-level key still writes through to Object.prototype.

landing_point.why: The advisory title names getQueryParam, and this is its only definition in first-party JS.

fix_sites.entry_point: Any FreeScout page URL query string, read by getQueryParam(name) through document.location.search (e.g. the search page, public/js/main.js:2774-2775)
fix_sites.module_kind: client-side JS helper in core frontend bundle

O3_reason_to_dismiss: No O2 site or O8 route found. The only argument available is that a 'third-dimension' or 'second-segment' __proto__ looks covered by the existing __proto__ skip at public/js/main.js:2396.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Legitimate array and nested query params (e.g. f[...] search filters, key[] arrays without indexes) must still expand into objects; a fix that drops every bracketed key would break search filters.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A helper that merges parsed query params into options through Object.assign, or a second query parser for module JS
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: main.js already merges option objects with Object.assign at this line, so a maintainer could plausibly feed parsed URL params into it.

O9_family: prototype pollution (CWE-1321), client-side JS query-string parser

O10_build.toolchain: composer (php>=7.1), plain JS with no bundler needed for public/js/main.js
services: MySQL/PostgreSQL for the app; none needed to unit-test the JS function in isolation
